# Labib Alam

> Labib Alam (Md Labib Alam) is a full stack and Gen AI developer based in Kolkata, India. He builds Laravel and React web apps, AI chatbots and booking systems, and is open to freelance projects and full time roles. His Laravel and React work runs in production on rental and ecommerce platforms with 10,000+ monthly users.

Key facts:
- Role: Full stack developer (Laravel, React, MERN, Java Spring Boot, Gen AI)
- Location: Kolkata, India
- Career started: April 2025
- Results: 40% faster API responses through query optimisation, indexing and Redis caching; 20+ modules and REST APIs shipped for rental and ecommerce platforms
- Contact: Labib.Alam@outlook.com, +91 81004 94661 (WhatsApp available)
- GitHub: https://github.com/Labib000
